rationale: The active DataIntegrationCredentialsResponse member is the response superset and is retained as the operation’s representable success object.

auth_method.description: The authentication method for this credential. Additional values may be added in the future; handle unknown values gracefully.

expires_at.description: The ISO-8601 formatted timestamp indicating when the credential expires.

scopes.description: The scopes granted to the access token.

missing_scopes.description: If the integration has requested scopes that aren't present on the access token, they're listed here.

credential.description: The credential object containing the vended secret.
